SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] What's the matter, Senpai?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Well, it's nothing really important anyway...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I see. Maybe we'll talk about it later.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] ...Wait, no matter how you look at it, that response is 
just way too indifferent!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Is that so?

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] Kousaka-kun, Kousaka-kun, Ruri-nee is just being 
shy.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] For real?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] H-Hinata? ...What is this child saying? There's a limit 
as far as false accusations go.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] ...I'm just saying, if the two of us had a talk, it'll be 
late by the time we get home.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I want to talk now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No good?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I-It's not that it's no good...

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] If you'd like, we can go somewhere else?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No, you don't have to be that considerate.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] Eh-, is that so~? It looks like Ruri-nee wants to talk 
with just you though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] T-That's not the case.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] Oh you~, your cheeks are flushed, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Hinata, you'll regret this later.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] So then, Senpai. What would you like to talk about?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...I see, I got it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] W-Wait.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] If you say it like that, it's going to bother me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Nah, it's fine. After some thinking, it's no different 
even if I talk about it after getting back.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] I'm saying that I'm bothered by it. Hurry up and 
speak your mind.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Alright, I'll say it then...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] What's wrong? Please hurry up and speak your 
mind.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Maybe another time, it's kind of embarrassing...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] E-Embarrassing? What on earth are you planning on 
saying...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] We're dating each other, aren't we?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] T-That's obvious, isn't it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] But look, as lovers, we haven't done anything of the 
sort...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] That might be so, but why say such a thing all of a 
sudden-

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] D-Don't tell me, you want to... to me, right here, so 
suddenly...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=28]That's not it![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] R-Really?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Isn't that obvious? There's no way, in front of so 
many people...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I agree... This is impossible, it's too sudden for me...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] W-Well, calm down.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] Whaaat, I was looking forward to this-

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: [FI] Nee-sama, your face is turning bright red.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...That's enough. Continue.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It can't be, that... that won't do. My sisters will see...

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] What, what!? Ruri-nee and Kousaka-kun are gonna 
kiss!

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: [FI] Gonna kiss!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Why does it have to turn out like this?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] T-That's right. First, we have to hold hands...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...! Wh-What are you making me say!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'm telling you, it's not like that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I just, well... we should go out on a date, once in a 
while.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Da-Date?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] A date with Senpai...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Kuroneko?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Fu...Fufufu...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hey, Kuroneko. You okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I-I'm okay. There's no problem at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That's fine then.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Date... Yes, that's right. It's standard practice for a 
pair of lovers...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] This is... yes, a holy ceremony where two people 
confirm their love for each other...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] If the religious organizations find out about this, I 
will again be tied to the prisons of darkness...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] ...No, there's no problem. If I unleash my true power 
hidden deep within me...

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] Kousaka-kun, aren't you going to stop her?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I mean, she looks kinda happy though...

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] It might seem that way, but the one who will be 
disappointed after returning back to reality would 
be Ruri-nee, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] Mainly, due to the people around us staring at her.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Got no choice then... Hey, Kuroneko, snap out of it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...*gasp* W-What is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Have you come to?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] What do you mean by "have you come to"? There 
was no problem to begin with.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Your face is all red though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Let's go on a date then.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] O-Okay.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] Kousaka-kun's incredible! It's as if Ruri-nee has 
become a normal girl...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Be silent.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] I-I'm praising you! Keep at it, Kousaka-kun!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] S-Should we go on a date then?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Y-Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] ...You know, it's like a conversation between two 
middle school students who just started dating.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Leave me alone.
